Which shortwave stations broadcast in Swahili?

In the A-26 schedule, 8 stations broadcast in Swahili. The most heavily scheduled include China Radio International, Radio France International, IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran, Radio Vaticana.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Swahili?

The most-used frequencies are 5985, 7215, 7245, 11790, 13645 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
